en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large church with tall round and pointed towers and Gothic-style arched windows. The building fills most of the frame, viewed from an angle, with a small garden or grassy area in the foreground. Printed captions in German at the top read "Freiberg i. Sa." and "St. Petrikirche." A vertical imprint along the left edge notes the publisher and the year 1905.
